name: Null-Scattering Path Integral Framework
aliases: Generalized Path Space for Volume Rendering
definition: A framework for volume rendering that defines path space including null-scattering vertices to handle participating media, using a measure that sums products of surface area and volume measures for different vertex types.
summary: The Null-Scattering Path Integral Framework formulates light transport in participating media as a Monte Carlo integration over a generalized path space that explicitly includes null-scattering vertices, enabling variance reduction techniques by treating null-scattering events as distinct vertex types.
